spans.s: Gomaṇḍalika (EI 18), officer in charge of the royal cattle. See Gokulika, Gokul-ādhikarin, etc.
gomaṭha (EI 12), name of a sattra-like institution built by a Musalman chief together with a step-well and a garden.
Gomin (IA 13), epithet of a Buddhist priest hailing from Gauḍa-viṣaya; supposed to denote a learned lay brother who held some high office on the establishment of a monastery.
gomūtrikā-bandha (CITD), the style of composition of a stanza, the second half of which repeats nearly all the syllables of the first.
